description: Use this when the user wants sequence diagram text checked without a drawing, for example "check my sequence diagram for unclosed blocks" or "which participants have no messages". Takes the same diagram text as make_sequence_diagram. Returns ready true or false; when a line breaks the grammar, the line number, the token and the reason; otherwise the participants with outgoing and incoming message counts, message counts by kind, the blocks with their lines, nesting depth and messages, activate lines with no deactivate, and participants that differ only in upper and lower case. Does not draw the diagram or make files, and does not read features of other diagram languages outside this grammar.

diagram.description:
The diagram in this line grammar, one statement per line, up to 60,000 characters: participant Name | actor Name | participant "Long Name" as Alias; A -> B: text (sync call), A ->> B: text (async), A --> B: text (reply), A -> A: text (self); note over A: text | note over A,B: text; alt condition / else condition / end, loop condition / end, opt condition / end; activate A | deactivate A; lines starting with # or %% are comments. Example: "actor User
User -> Web: Log in
Web -> DB: Find user
DB --> Web: User row
alt password ok
Web --> User: Welcome
else wrong password
Web --> User: Try again
end".

name: check_sequence
title: Check sequence diagram text
